executivePulse.interpretation: The situation for memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM/RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the tightest segments. The Daily Check of 2026-08-23 reviewed 8 relevant current reports; it does not indicate any confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields could relieve pressure, but will reach the market only with a delay. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
